basic_info.description: Discover the potential of 248 Miramar Avenue  a classic San Francisco home in the heart of Ingleside, offering flexibility, space, and a prime location just waiting for your personal touch. This 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence with 1 car garage is ready for a cosmetic update, providing the perfect opportunity for homeowners or investors to customize and add value.    The upper level features a generous living area, a bright and spacious kitchen with access to the yard, and a formal dining room that can easily be converted into a third bedroom to suit your needs. Original character details blend seamlessly with modern comfort, providing the perfect canvas for your personal touch. Downstairs, the expansive 2-car tandem garage presents an excellent opportunity to create additional living space. Conveniently located just one block from Ocean Avenue's dining, shopping, and the MUNI K line, this home offers easy commuting to the Financial District and Stonestown Mall. You're just a 3-minute drive to City College of San Francisco, 4 minutes to 280, Balboa Park BART, and amenities. 248 Miramar Ave is a rare opportunity to reimagine a classic home in a sought-after neighborhood with excellent access to transit, schools, and local amenities. Bring your vision and unlock the potential.
